gate: docs/PROJ_PATH_SHAPE_GATE.md (sections 4 and 5, under amendment A-2: war_provider = fwar)
read: OWNER-WAIVED EARLY READ (owner EW3-5, 2026-10-14, verbatim: 'Fuck the registered look days and waiting, we don't have to wait for anything. Let's do everything today'); recorded in section 24 of the gate document

sentences.basis: Every criterion in this battery is scored on `war_provider = fwar`. The champion-versus-challenger numbers in `data/proj_horizon_eval.json` (2026-08-19) and every cell of `data/proj_calibration_eval.json` (2026-07-25) predate the fWAR label epoch (docs/efv-2026-09-17/FWAR_LABEL_EPOCH_GATE.md) and are priors, not comparators. Label seasons 2015 through 2025 were already scored on the shipped challenger by `challenger_blocks.gate1_targets` and carry no confirming verdict here.
sentences.roughness: An absent season is scored as 0.0 WAR, so the expected path of a population whose survival probability decays is genuinely not smooth in age. Part of the roughness removed here is attrition signal, and the accuracy column is what prices that. RS2 falls by construction under a second-difference penalty and no verdict here turns on it in the passing direction.
sentences.two_way: The served two-way population is one player. Each side's model estimates the player's TOTAL WAR given that side's line, so the two sides are two estimates of one quantity, and no claim about two-way accuracy is supported by this battery in either direction. The served two-way `war` sum carries no workload discount and no clause here adjudicates that.
sentences.transport: The verdict-bearing frame is label seasons 2012-2014, and the served population is 2027. Transport across that gap is disclosed, not demonstrated.

defaults: D1 L1 exclusion: a frame row whose base season (B - 1) is two-sided and a cell whose label season (B + h - 1) is two-sided are excluded from every fit and every scored cell, for every arm and for S
D2 point-in-time blends pool every earlier base from 2004 whose cells carry labels <= B - 1
D3 mean blend: lift-only, grid 0.0 to 1.0 by 0.1, the smallest |bias| among the lambdas whose MAE stays strictly below the champion's on the same cells

D4 star blend: tools/fit_star_blend.py's rule on top of the mean-blended q50 (predict_path's order); h2 served at 0 for both arms (the incumbent's h2 failed its confirmation), the fitted value published
D5 the joint heads read the frame's features plus horizon and age_at_target
D6 the power lab's calibration candidate is lambda 0.20; the measured ratio applies to every lambda
D7 B-AGE's cell statistic is the n-weighted mean |bias| over the four registered age cells; its floor is the bootstrap sd of their prior-signed mean bias
D8 B-C's primary form is a multiplicative factor on the catcher central path (projected PT times rate scaled together); its twin is an additive level
D9 the A-SHAPE recount is the battery's serving replica (it reproduces the served `war` on 1,400 of 1,400 rows through the live bundle) run through the candidate's serving-depth bundle and blends

D10 Tripwire 2's champion-stack share is the permutation importance of champ_h1..h5 permuted together on the served veteran inputs: mean((c - c_perm)^2) / (2 var(c)), h1..h5 and both sides pooled, seed 20260611
D11 an UNDERPOWERED lever (B-F8) enters the Holm family under the 5.5a substitution, the conservative direction for the other two

D12 this battery flips no flag (8.2), so B0-GATE and every lever read the incumbent whatever ARM A's verdict; on an ARM A PASS, B-STAR reads NOT_AVAILABLE until the owner flips SERVE_SHAPE_REFIT, and enters the Holm family under 5.5a
